sources.title: 'Not the same Roger.' 20 years in, Goodell's NFL is bigger than ever | Opinion
sources.description: Twenty years after becoming NFL commissioner, Roger Goodell has proven to be far from perfect. But he's an All-Pro at making bank, writes columnist Jarrett Bell.
